r.s: Abstraction of various SASL mechanism responses
r.d: Provides code to generate responses to common SASL mechanisms, including: - Anonymous - Cram-MD5 (DEPRECATED) - Digest-MD5 (DEPRECATED) - External - Login (Pseudo mechanism) (DEPRECATED) - Plain - SCRAM
r.n: * feature: PHP8.2 ready * bugfix: scram-sha-224 broken #14 * task: mark authentication methods cram-md5, digest-md5, and login as deprecated #14
